verdict.rationale: An AI-training opt-out or no-training data commitment is a fair privacy question for a financial SaaS platform that holds sensitive customer data, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no policy, setting, or contractual commitment on whether customer data is used to train AI models. The AgentOS, MCP and CLI docs cover agent access and safety guardrails, not training-data use, and the community data-residency allegation is off-topic.
